name: auth_update_user
description: Use this to disable, enable, or set a custom claim on a specific user's account.

json_value.description: Set the claim to a complex JSON value like an object or an array by providing stringified JSON. String must be parseable as valid JSON. One of `value` or `json_value` must be provided if setting a claim.

key.description: the name (key) of the claim to update, e.g. 'admin'

value.description: Set the value of the custom claim to the specified simple scalar value. One of `value` or `json_value` must be provided if setting a claim.

disabled.description: true disables the user, false enables the user

uid.description: the UID of the user to update
